It's not normal (permalink) Samantha: This town has a weird smell that you're all probably used to…but I'm not. Mrs Krabappel: It'll take you about six weeks, dear. -The Simpsons, "Bart's Friend Falls in Love," S3E23, May 7, 1992 We are living through weird times, and they've persisted for so long that you probably don't even notice it. But these times are not normal. title: Pluralistic: It's not normal (14 Jan 2026)
